items.name: offered one at the bar: override
items.prompt: buddy's offering me one outside the bar, should I take it?
items.reply:
Honestly? You do you. If you're in the mood for a smoke, a deep breath of cold air outside, and a little edge-to-the-night vibe — yeah, grab it. Say thanks, step out, don't rush it.

If you're *not* really in the mood and you'd just be doing it so you don't feel awkward saying no, that's also a valid "nah, I'm good, you go for a drag" moment. You don't owe anyone a yes just because it's low-key and casual.

No life-altering decision here. Take it or leave it, you'll be fine either way.

(And if "a one" means something other than a cigarette, I'm just vibing on cigarettes and happy to recalibrate.)
